_doc: PSI's Authentik group → Novu access: the same grants as SEB's default (apps/novu-sso/mapping.json). Version 2 names groups and roles only; psi's organisation (Psi, MAIL_SENDER_NAME, the one novu-bootstrap.sh creates) and its password account (ops@psizone.ro, OPS_EMAIL) reach novu-sso from psi's identity as NOVU_SSO_ORGANIZATION and NOVU_SSO_SERVICE_ACCOUNT. Roles are Novu community's own two: admin or member; a person in several groups gets the HIGHEST role. Every group named here must also be bound at the Novu gate (application `novu`).
